description.value: Hope River General Store is a family-owned roadside institution established in 2001 along the Trans-Canada Highway in the Fraser Canyon, attached to Emory Bar RV Park. It combines a general store, in-house bakery and deli, licensed restaurant, gift shop featuring First Nations arts and crafts, and an ESSO Gas Bar — making it a notable all-in-one stop in an otherwise rural stretch of highway. The store is particularly well known for its smoked sockeye salmon, Indian candy, and complimentary salmon BBQ on July 1st.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operational general store and deli at an ESSO Gas Bar along the Trans-Canada Highway in the Fraser Canyon, part of the Emory Bar RV Park complex. The store page lists offerings including in-store bakery & deli, fresh fruit & produce, ice cream, and reviews confirm basic groceries and hot food (restaurant with daily specials, milkshakes, smoked salmon sandwiches). A notable address discrepancy exists: OSM records 28605 Trans-Canada Hwy, V0X 1L0 while the website consistently shows 28775 Trans Canada HWY, V0X 1L3. No bike-specific amenities (parking, pump, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists 28605 Trans-Canada Highway, V0X 1L0, but the website consistently shows 28775 Trans Canada HWY, Hope, BC V0X 1L3. Both the street number and postal code differ — OSM address may be incorrect.
OSM record has no phone number; website lists two numbers (604-863-2407 / 604-863-0033).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational business with an active website and positive recent reviews; a natural stop for touring cyclists on this rural Trans-Canada corridor offering food, fuel, and groceries.
enrichment_extras.notes: The ESSO Gas Bar is listed among store offerings on the website, which may be useful context for cyclists needing fuel-adjacent services, though propane or camping-specific fuel is not confirmed.
